description: Jet 4 MDB: SQL INSERT & UPDATE assignment conversions on TS(ID PK, B BYTE, I SMALLINT, L LONG, S SINGLE, D DOUBLE, C CURRENCY, DT DATETIME, Y YESNO, DC DECIMAL(18,4), T TEXT(10)): valid text-to-numeric/date/currency/boolean/decimal, rounding ties, numeric/date/bool-to-text, Null into Yes/No, bad text ('abc', '') & overflow errors under dbFailOnError, and UPDATE conversions + Text(10) truncation vs error. Keeps all pages before/after setup, writes, and Close; reads back persisted rows.
